what: CHORD RUN's chiptune sibling: game-style chord progressions on the black keys, a scale-matched melody on the white keys. 20 sets, chip sounds and the fast chip arpeggio, 20 chip drum grooves and a DRUM STUDIO with 20 user slots, a bitcrusher, an 8-bar chord looper, and a pixel runner with missions.
author: swtdr34mz (based on Blop by Obsimo)
